_about: Fixes and fields the website needs that Beyond-The-Jersey/data doesn't have yet. scripts/build-live-data.ts merges this onto the data repo's normalized/ and writes data/live/. Sections it understands: levels, sponsors, kits, deals, clubs (fields merged by id), ratingHolds (sponsorId: reason; shown as not rated yet, data kept), claimEdits (claimId: [[exact text, replacement]]) and deadUrls. Since Beyond-The-Jersey/data#278 (5c4b022) the design copy, why texts, rating holds and claim clean-ups live in the data repo; only the dead links are left here. Anything added here should be proposed upstream too.

deadUrls._about: Links that returned 404 on 2026-09-25 (checked with a browser user agent). The source stays, without the link; contact channels are dropped.
deadUrls.https://github.com/Beyond-The-Jersey/dat: a private issue in the data repo, not a public source (2026-09-25)
